integer_semantics: All mastery and confidence cutoffs are exact inclusive integers; no average, tolerance, rounding, or float coercion is permitted.
d10_overrides: Self-assessed, disputed, unresolved attribution, or unresolved assistance inputs remain deferred until substantive review; policy comparison never rewrites their values.
promotion_rule: Only a separate immediate-next-anchor decision with distinct same-Skill Contributions, contexts, and anchor behaviors may promote a max baseline.
duplicate_rule: Same-Skill duplicate relationships and incidental evidence volume cannot increase mastery.
